inlines.v: CORRUPTIBLE, adjective 1. That may be corrupted; that may become putrid; subject to decay and destruction. Our bodies are corruptible 2. That may be vitiated in qualities or principles; susceptible of depravation. Manners are corruptible by evil example. CORRUPTIBLE, noun That which may decay and perish; the human body. This corruptible must put on incorruption. 1 Corinthians 15:53.
